page: UpCloud GPU-16xCPU-80GB-1xRTXPRO6000 is a GPU-accelerated server virtualized via the KVM hypervisor. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an AMD EPYC 9555 processor containing 16 physical cores, delivering 16 vCPUs with a single thread per core under a shared allocation model. The processor operates at a base speed of 2.0 GHz. The system is configured with 80.0 GB of system memory, yielding 5.0 GB of RAM per core. Graphics and parallel computing acceleration are provided by a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPU equipped with 96 GB of dedicated VRAM. This server configuration does not include local storage.

In benchmark evaluations, this server demonstrates top-tier performance in single-core processing and memory throughput. Both stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core benchmarks place the processor in the top 10% of tested systems. Large-block memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching 444.94 GB/sec for read operations and 279.59 GB/sec for write operations, both ranking in the top tier. Multi-core performance is strong, with Geekbench multi-core and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression scores placing in the top 25%. The hardware excels at large language model inference, achieving top-tier prompt processing and text generation speeds for both small (135M) and medium (7B) models.

From a resource density perspective, the server offers a specialized hardware profile that pairs a high-capacity 96 GB VRAM GPU with a moderate 16-core CPU allocation. The shared CPU allocation represents a potential performance tradeoff for workloads requiring sustained, exclusive CPU execution, though the physical core count mitigates this. Because local storage is not bundled, users must provision external block storage to support the operating system and application data.

This instance is highly suited for GPU-accelerated workloads, particularly machine learning inference for small to medium models, image processing, and data science tasks. It is also well-suited for single-threaded compression tasks and applications requiring high memory bandwidth.
description: The UpCloud GPU-16xCPU-80GB-1xRTXPRO6000 is a KVM-based, GPU-accelerated server designed for compute-intensive workloads. It features an AMD EPYC 9555 processor with 16 physical cores (16 vCPUs) running at 2.0 GHz, paired with 80.0 GB of system memory. The primary accelerator is a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPU with 96 GB of VRAM. This server does not include local storage. In benchmark testing, it demonstrates top-tier single-core CPU performance, high large-block memory bandwidth, and exceptional LLM inference speeds for small and medium models. Multi-core performance and physics simulations are also strong. Given its specialized hardware profile, this instance is highly suited for machine learning inference, image processing, and data science applications, offering a balanced ratio of system memory to high-capacity VRAM.
